one_line: New AI model targets security, data‑sharing rules issued, data‑centre growth faces pushback, safety patches roll out.

themes.title: Mistral launches security‑focused AI model
themes.text: Mistral AI released Large 4, a multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and 52 billion active parameters, designed to help organisations identify and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities. The model can be downloaded and run independently, unlike many cloud‑based AI services.

stories.headline: Mistral AI releases Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter model for cybersecurity

themes.title: India releases DEPA data‑sharing handbook
themes.text: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture (DEPA), outlining a techno‑legal framework that enables institutions to share data for AI training while retaining control through contractual permissions, clean rooms and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: AI data‑centre expansion meets opposition
themes.text: State lawmakers in Arizona are pushing back against new AI data centre projects due to water depletion concerns, while Indian startup CapGrid raised ₹50 cr to expand into drone manufacturing and data‑centre markets, and Core 4 Solutions listed a decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million.

stories.headline: Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona
CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
Core 4 Solutions lists decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million

themes.title: Safety updates target AI misuse
themes.text: The Volta‑Autodoxer malware sends victim data to large language models to rank assets, Anthropic added a rule to Claude Code and Opus 5.5 that blocks AI‑generated video‑game clones, and OpenAI patched a chain of vulnerabilities in ChatGPT’s HTML preview sandbox, issuing a $5,000 bug bounty.

stories.headline: Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets
OpenAI patches HTML preview exploit that let attackers hijack ChatGPT accounts
Anthropic adds rule to block AI-generated video game clones
